name: PingOne LAB
description: A card for each thing PingOne can do for apps and AI agents that its discovery document advertises: pi.flow sign-in, PKCE, PAR, JAR, client credentials, token lifecycle, Userinfo, device authorization, CIBA, token exchange and a playground. Runs on a mock PingOne or your own environment.
notes: Host-run: npm install && npm run build && npm start (port 5500, loopback only; mock mode needs no settings). Docker: copy .env.example to .env, then docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:5500 only, https). Catalog id A29 is accepted (owner, 2026-10-31).json if the owner changes it.
